name: open-helpers
description: Shared post-open view-mode helper. customJS.OpenHelpers.forceActiveLeafPreview() flips the active markdown leaf to reading mode after a create-and-open dispatch, deferred one macrotask + guarded (markdown-only, never throws, skips kanban/board leaves). Routes every new-note create path to read mode so notes never open in edit-with-title-selected. v0.1.0 launch (sauce v0.120.3).
